keywords_glossary.role: Official XML documentation comments powering IntelliSense and OpenAPI/NuGet docs.
Built-in .NET 8/C# 12 guard throwing on null, empty, or whitespace strings in one call.
Clean string interpolation that trims leading and trailing whitespace.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 4 spaces for class members and 8 spaces inside method bodies.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Allman style: every opening { and closing } brace sits on its own line.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Semicolons ending statements and double quotes on XML attributes name="...".
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: XML /// <summary> blocks on both class and method plus <param> and <returns>.

keywords_glossary.role: C# 12 primary constructor syntax removing separate constructor boilerplate.
Null-coalescing throw expression validating injected dependencies at construction.
keywords_glossary.example_inline: private readonly ILogger _log = log ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(log));

keywords_glossary.role: Documents primary constructor parameters directly on the class XML Doc block.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 4 spaces for the private readonly field inside the class body.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Allman braces on their own lines beneath the primary constructor class header.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Uses nameof(...) inside ArgumentNullException to avoid magic parameter strings.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: XML /// <summary> and /// <param> placed directly above the class declaration.

analogous_example.title: Billing notification service using a C# 12 primary constructor
analogous_example.why_it_works: Declares IMailer on the class header, guards against null with ?? throw, and documents via <param>.
